title: Split Flap
description: A film played on a split-flap board. Every cell is a pair of real flaps carrying a tile of the picture, and a flap only falls when its piece of the frame changes, so motion ripples across the board while the still parts hold. Watch a red flower open and close, switch to a 1940 switchboard scene, or drop in a video of your own.
intent: One physical mechanism finished to the edge: real hinged flaps with a fall, a bounce and shading, now carrying moving pictures instead of letters; the board's own limits (one flap at a time per cell) become the look of the film.
sources: Switchboard clip: His Girl Friday (1940), public domain; the short excerpt friday.mp4 from MDN's CC0 video assets, https://github.com/mdn/interactive-examples (live-examples/media/cc0-videos) and https://github.com/mdn/shared-assets (videos/friday.mp4)
Bloom clip: flower.mp4 from MDN's CC0 video assets, same repositories (videos/flower.mp4), played forward then reversed
